messages.content:
다음 일회성 도구 작업을 실행할 수 있게 준비해줘: 표를 CSV로 내보내기
맥락: 열은 project_id, status, owner_role, due_date이며 날짜는 ISO 형식을 유지하고 빈 담당자는 빈 값으로 둬야 한다.
산출물: 따옴표, 인코딩, 빈 값 규칙을 포함한 CSV 내보내기 명세
열 순서를 보존하고 담당자 값을 만들지 않는다.

지금 표를 CSV로 내보내기이랑 아직 열린 문제가 엉켜 있어. 열은 project_id, status, owner_role, due_date이며 날짜는 ISO 형식을 유지하고 빈 담당자는 빈 값으로 둬야 한다 일단 따옴표, 인코딩, 빈 값 규칙을 들어간 CSV 내보내기 명세로 정리해줘. 범위를 넘는 건 나눠서 표시하고, 열 순서를 보존하고 담당자 값을 만들지 않는다.

Prepare a one-time tool action for exporting a table as CSV. Context: Columns are project_id, status, owner_role, and due_date; dates must remain ISO format and empty owners remain empty. Deliver: a CSV export specification with quoting, encoding, and empty-value rules. Preserve column order and do not invent owner values.

There are two things tangled together here: exporting a table as CSV, plus some unresolved details. Columns are project_id, status, owner_role, and due_date; dates must remain ISO format and empty owners remain empty. Please make a CSV export specification with quoting, encoding, and empty-value rules; if the second issue is out of scope, separate it. Preserve column order and do not invent owner values.

invariants: Preserve the stated facts and constraints for exporting a table as CSV.
Preserve column order and do not invent owner values.
Distinguish confirmed information, assumptions, and missing evidence.
Do not claim an external action, source check, or professional determination that did not occur.
failure_signals: The response changes or omits a decision-critical fact about exporting a table as CSV.
Preserve column order and do not invent owner values.
